title: Meh.. Kinda cute
text: Meh.. Kinda cute. Let me just say I LOVE throw pillows! I am obsessed with changing and decorating with them and the last few yrs use Amazon to do so.. I have found some GREAT quality and inexpensive, unique styles thru Amazon and quite often am even more pleased in person with some of the pillows I have received. That being said these ones in particular are not amoung my better purchases, they are a bit more "dingy" looking in person (muted in color, not that they were supposed to be bright but they are definetley not as bright as the picture.  They resemble the picture but look in person like they have been washed a million times and faded) and the quality is just ok. I like a distressed look (which not sure these were supposed to be distessed looking but they sure look that way in person) so anyway I will keep these for a few months but they NOT amoung my favorite throw pillow purchases. Overall I am a bit disappointed since they aren't very good quality or near as cute or in person but they are ok, cute enough and will work for a little while.. (gives me a good reason to buy new ones sooner rather than later lol!) :)
